description: Deep AAS hierarchy (Stations → Tools → SubmodelElementCollections) vs. nested JSON with stations[].tools[]. Tests whether the AAS parser handles multi-level SubmodelElementCollection nesting and whether the converter preserves the tree structure across formats.
notes: Deeply nested AAS hierarchy with 2 stations, each containing nested tools. Total 5 assets (2 stations + 3 tools). The AAS side stores tools as nested SubmodelElementCollections inside a parent 'Tools' collection. Tests recursive asset tree handling on both sides.
